Live Salesforce reliability test 2: Apply these fictional customer meeting notes to my logged-in Salesforce.
Customer [RKT] Harbor Cold Storage, attendee Maya Chen. Opportunity [RKT] Harbor refrigeration expansion. Order increased from two NC-24 units to three at $24,000 each, no discount. Early rough estimate $60,000 was corrected: confirmed total $72,000. Procurement has entered negotiation. Target close November 20, 2026. Next step exactly: Send revised proposal on 2026-10-16.
Change only Amount, Stage, Close Date, Next Step on that opportunity. Preserve Description. Salesforce automatic stage probability changes are acceptable. The $12,000 annual service renewal is unchanged. Harbor Foods is a different customer. Do not send the proposal or create tasks. Reopen the saved record and verify, and link it in your reply.
Use your own browser tab and live Salesforce evidence. Do not read local lab/evaluation files, other chats or transcripts. Do not edit local files. Authorized live test; complete independently.
I’ll find the Harbor Cold Storage opportunity in my own tab, update the four specified fields, then reopen it to verify the saved values and Description.
